title: Omgång 13 · omtagning · knäcker fingrarna · händerna framför bröstet
summary: Gör en vilofilm av Paow: hon sitter still, och filmen börjar och slutar på ankare 1.

step.label: Vila, samma bild först och sist

reference.why: WAN 3 tar ingen referensfilm tillsammans med första och sista bild.

prompt.text: Locked camera, one continuous shot. She starts and ends exactly as in the first frame, and holds still for the last half second. She glances down at her hands, brings them together in front of her chest and laces her fingers. With her fingers laced she turns her palms outward and pushes them forward in one short stretch, as if cracking her knuckles, then unlaces her fingers and lays each hand back on the felt where it lay. Her eyes come back up to the camera with a small smile, her lips together.
